text:
Mia: quick PSA — noticed a batch of webinar leads not making it into the RR because enrichment callback failed. a few VIPs sat unassigned.
Sam: ah damn. any error codes from the enrichment side?
Mia: enrich-bot shows multiple 502/504 during the 16:10-16:18 UTC window. callbacks retried but HS never got the property flip.
enrich-bot: alert: 11 enrichment callbacks failed (502/504) between 16:10-16:18 UTC; retries exhausted.
Lee: sounds like transient overload. can we add a time-based escape hatch in the HS workflow to avoid holding leads forever?
Ashley: yes please — CS hit us about two missed follow-ups. short-circuit would help.
Raj: proposal: if enrichment_started_at older than 4m AND source in (webinar, api) then assign to fallback SDR pool and set `needs_enrich=true`. limit to non-enterprise leads.
Sam: low-friction change in HS workflow UI. i'll apply at 02:00 PDT and smoke test.
Lee: i'll also add a metric in Datadog: fallback_count / new_contacts over 15m and alert at 0.8% to catch regressions early.
Ashley: SDR copy request: short script for when `needs_enrich` present. i'll draft and share.
Raj: long-term: make callbacks idempotent + improve retry/backoff. adding `enrich_retry_count` prop so we can avoid double work.
Mia: can someone create a tracking ticket and link workflow id?
Sam: created RDW-1601 and linked HS workflow 99222. assigning to @lee and @raj.
Sam: deployed the timed-fallback change, tested with synthetic leads — they route to SDR-fallback after 4m. rollback steps in RDW-1601.
Lee: monitor in place, slack alert wired to #marketing if fallback > 0.8% over 15m.
Ashley: shared SDR blurb in #marketing-collab. short checklist included.
Raj: keeping RDW-1601 open until callback shim is live. marking thread for postmortem.
Mia: confirmed test VIPs got assigned and CS reached out. thanks team :thumbsup:
